text:
```yaml
name: Publish
on:
  release:
    types: [created]
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
